author: RowRow
text_post: This is depressing Today was my birthday and the only congratulations I got where from my family and relatives . Logged into my FB account - not a single of my 50 friends had congratulated me. Not even by phone, not even by text message. The thing is I had a relatively good relationship with most of my course, people I know, but apparently none of them really care about me. I feel alone to be honest. I have only one real friend and we never congratulate each other, so that's ok, but all the other people I know are only sort-of friends, colleges that do not really care as it seems. How do I become more popular? I want to be loved other people. I already have worked on myself a lot and am extroverted/social, but apparently it's not enough. I haven't gotten a friend invite in MONTHS.

author: herculain
text_post: Do you like to make people feel good when you socialize? Well done! You have got frustrated with your life!  Now it is time for you to you to use that frustration and make it better.. Cheer up! It is the begining. Do not live in the past. Accept everything that has happened in the past as your choice. You chose to do everything you did to have that happen to you. Own it. Remember now that your past does not equal your future. What has transpired before is not going to happen to you in your future. How do you get good friends? Well you get good friends by being a good friend yourself. You have to give something that people value in order to be valued by other people. Other people have their own shit going on in their lives and so they don't wanna hear about yours. So when you are with other people, be the most positive guy they could find. The most uplifting. When you bring people out of their sorrow it is like a drug. They will automatically seek you out.  Make a new mission statement in life. e.g.:  The purpose of my life is to make more people smile! To sincerely enjoy everyones company and to never judge other people. I seriously love people. Happy Birthday dude! Welcome to your new reality! Your gonna love it!

author: herculain
text_post: Be a happy person. This begs the question: How can I be happy when I have no birthday wishes? Instead of asking yourself that question.. (Which will only make you feel depressed) Ask yourself this: What have I had in my life that I am grateful for? You will almost certainly have something you are grateful for. Then ask yourself this. Does putting emphasis on other peoples opinion make me happy? The answer is almost certainly no. So put more emphasis on liking yourself and being centred in yourself. When you base your happiness on something outside of your control you become unhappy. Rather find something that makes you happy now which you have control over. e.g. I am happy when I treat people with respect I am happy when I greet people on their birthdays. I am happy when I make people smile. instead of  I am happy when other people smile at me. or.  I am happy when people greet me Happy birthday. These things are out of your control. Something else might be happening in their lives that could affect their interaction with you.. e.g. Their grandfather died... Would they wish you happy birthday?
